title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage is joining Steam Next Fest - the demo now has new voyage events, focus categories and an ambience mixer
author: Grand-Scheme1793
selftext:
Hi everyone, back in August I shared Dive Log: A Focus Voyage here, a submarine treasure-hunting game that combines a pomodoro timer with idle progression.

The demo is joining Steam Next Fest (Oct 19-26), and here's what has been updated since then:

* Many more Captain's Log events, and the riskier the route, the more they affect your haul.
* Categories: label each focus session before setting sail, and the diary breaks down your time by category.
* Ambience is now a mixer that plays up to 4 tracks at once, plus 5 new tracks including a ticking clock, a cafe and a thunderstorm.

During development I used AI for programming assistance and multilingual localization, while I handle the game design and balancing myself.

I'd love your thoughts: would you take a riskier route for a bigger haul? At what point did you start to feel there was nothing new to aim for? And if you played the August version, I'd like to hear how this one feels.

Free demo on Steam:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4985770/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4985770/)
